legend: Piegirl got bored with binary, decimal and other integer based counting systems. Recently she discovered some interesting properties about number ![](https://espresso.codeforces.com/cf667d5378aa3553058e0b348b30c37378759ffd.png), in particular that q2 = q + 1, and she thinks it would make a good base for her new unique system. She called it "golden system". In golden system the number is a non-empty string containing 0's and 1's as digits. The decimal value of expression a0a1...an equals to ![](https://espresso.codeforces.com/51c20c3ef1a1e517fd60f28ab2fdea1fd54d65c7.png).

Soon Piegirl found out that this system doesn't have same properties that integer base systems do and some operations can not be performed on it. She wasn't able to come up with a fast way of comparing two numbers. She is asking for your help.
Given two numbers written in golden system notation, determine which of them has larger decimal value.
input: Input consists of two lines — one for each number. Each line contains non-empty string consisting of '0' and '1' characters. The length of each string does not exceed 100000.
output: Print ">" if the first number is larger, "<" if it is smaller and "=" if they are equal.
note: In the first example first number equals to ![](https://espresso.codeforces.com/9c955eec678d6e7dcdc7c94fb203e922d2ad19ad.png), while second number is approximately 1.6180339882 + 1.618033988 + 1 ≈ 5.236, which is clearly a bigger number.
In the second example numbers are equal. Each of them is  ≈ 2.618.

legend.ai: Piegirl 厌倦了二进制、十进制以及其他基于整数的计数系统。最近，她发现了关于数 ![](https://espresso.codeforces.com/cf667d5378aa3553058e0b348b30c37378759ffd.png) 的一些有趣性质，特别是 q2 = q + 1，并认为它很适合作为她全新的独特数制的基数。她将其称为“黄金进制”。在黄金进制中，一个数是由 0 和 1 作为数字组成的非空字符串。表达式 a0a1...an 的十进制值等于 ![](https://espresso.codeforces.com/51c20c3ef1a1e517fd60f28ab2fdea1fd54d65c7.png)。
不久，Piegirl 发现这种数制并不具备整数进制所具有的相同性质，有些运算无法在其中进行。她没能想出一种快速比较两个数的方法，因此向你求助。
给定两个用黄金进制表示的数，判断它们中哪个的十进制值更大。

input.ai: 输入包含两行，分别对应两个数。每行包含一个由字符 ‘0’ 和 ‘1’ 组成的非空字符串。每个字符串的长度不超过 100000。

output.ai: 如果第一个数更大，输出“>”；如果更小，输出“<”；如果两者相等，输出“=”。

note.ai: 在第一个样例中，第一个数等于 ![](https://espresso.codeforces.com/9c955eec678d6e7dcdc7c94fb203e922d2ad19ad.png)，而第二个数约为 1.6180339882 + 1.618033988 + 1 ≈ 5.236，显然是一个更大的数。
在第二个样例中，两个数相等。它们都约等于 2.618。
